name: Suspicious Workstation Locking via Rundll32
description: Detects a suspicious call to the user32.dll function that locks the user workstation
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Scripts or links on the user desktop used to lock the workstation instead of Windows+L or the menu option
query: (process.executable:*\\rundll32.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:RUNDLL32.EXE) AND process.parent.executable:*\\cmd.exe AND process.command_line:*user32.dll,* AND process.command_line:*LockWorkStation*
